scope: Every retained equity-underlying discovery, with research-only and options-source cohorts separately labeled
cutoff_reason: October 8 cached marks were fetched before that session closed; exclude the whole current session consistently rather than assume its cached close was final
episode_rule_executed: Earliest ticker/lane observation with no overlapping outcome window, independently for each horizon and entry basis
primary_comparison: Earliest nonoverlapping ticker/lane episodes, same-horizon underlying returns versus SPY. Signal marks are diagnostic; next eligible RTH-open entries are modeled counterfactuals, not actual fills.
alternatives_without_optimization: Fixed initial stops of -10% versus -8%, on the same next-session-open cohort
Tiered full-position profit floors at strictly over +5%, +10%, +20%, with existing uncapped higher floor schedule, activated only after completed-bar high in daily model
Declared 1/3/5/10/20 session holding windows, all reported rather than selectively showing best
Descriptive entry-time score and independent-signal-count cohorts only when those frozen fields exist
holdout: Retrospective chronological last 30% of operating-period sessions, with training labels crossing the boundary purged. Not a prospectively untouched holdout because prior terminal reports have inspected parts of this history.
inference: Ticker-cluster bootstrap for descriptive means and paired differences; no IID confidence claims; small holdout cohorts inconclusive; selection/multiple-testing caveats retained
restrictions: No optimizer or live strategy changes
No portfolio CAGR/Sharpe/account return from averaged signal returns
No guaranteed stop fill or guaranteed +5% profit
No corporate-action adjustment claims without evidence
All provider failures, immature horizons and invalid observations reported
